data.narrative:
Heven AeroTech is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Bentzion Levinson, currently valued at $1.0B post-money with $100M+ raised to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comparable universe of 10 companies across the sector: 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, including Dream Security, Allen Control Systems, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, and Twenty, which span valuations from $300M to $3.0B at the same stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression approach applies a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier from Series B to later funding rounds, yielding $1.9B. The Peer-Median method derives from 7 same-sector, same-stage private comparables with a median valuation of $1.2B and a range of $300M to $3.0B. These methods triangulate to a low estimate of $1.1B, median of $1.6B, and high of $2.2B.

The median implied valuation of $1.6B represents a 60% step-up from the current $1.0B post-money, which falls within typical Series B dynamics. Key valuation uncertainties include differentiation relative to the broad peer set (which spans a wide $3B range) and stage-specific risk factors not captured in static multiples. The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.1B to $2.2B, with $1.6B as the central estimate.
